title: Field Comms QuickPack: Rapid Response Scripts, Battle Prompts & Release Notes Sync
creator: Miguel Ramos
description: Create a compact enablement pack (QuickPack) for field Sales & Customer Success that pairs: concise battle prompts, objection handling scripts, triage/resolution runbooks for launch incidents, synchronized release-note highlights, and lightweight demo scripts. The QuickPack must be consumable in a 30-minute ramp session and usable as a one-page refresher during calls. Coordinate with Docs (release-notes), Design (one-pager layout), and Solutions Engineering (demo flows).
deliverables: 3 short demo scripts (30s, 2min, 5min) with step-by-step prompts
Incident triage checklist and escalation paths
Release notes TL;DR and affected feature callouts
acceptance_criteria: QuickPack PDF approved by Product, Design, and Sales Ops
Demo scripts validated in 2 rehearsal sessions with Solutions Eng
Release notes TL;DR pulled from canonical release-notes doc and included
CS playbook includes triage steps and clear SLA/escalation owners
All assets uploaded to enablement folder and linked in sales CRM
tasks: Sync with Release Notes owner to extract 3 key customer-facing bullets
Draft objection matrix based on field interviews (engineers and AEs)
Design comp for one-pager and approved copy
Finalize assets and publish to Drive + link in SalesOps playbook
